title: Writing evals that evolve
concept: An agent turns its own failures into a small suite of code graders, checks the suite against hidden labels it never sees, and keeps it as a skill. The papers behind it are P24 (the evals cheat sheet), P25 (agents that write, call, grade and review agents) and P17 (simulate then validate); their licences are in docs/lenses/papers.md.
free_first_lesson: read the ten logged failures of a support agent and group them by what went wrong, with no suite written and nothing scored

generator.seed_source: the log head at the time of the sitting, the holder and the attempt: nothing the learner controls ahead of time

scorer.description: the suite's catch rate on faulty answers and its false-fail rate on good ones, on 40 held-out cases per run (ten faulty, all five fault kinds, a mix practice never showed)
scorer.checker: Cohen's kappa of the suite's flags against the hidden labels, which the suite is never tuned on; a suite that carries a token of the held-out set is refused

artifact.description: a list of at most twelve code graders (absent, present, number_over, same_as_input) that flag a bad reply

gate.metric: catch rate at least 70%, false-fail rate at most 15%, kappa at least 0.6
gate.note: every one of the five runs must meet the three marks; the mean and the error bar are reported; below it there is no credit and no artifact is kept

write_back.note: the suite enters the agent's memory as a lesson through the lesson gate, with the Action of the sitting as its evidence, as one signed change in its lineage

grading.note: the rates and kappa are deterministic; the grouping of failures in the free lesson is not scored

teacher.options: self-paced against the generator; a peer teacher who has passed it earns 20% of the price; a cohort works the same practice seed

cohort: a cohort shares the practice seed and sits on different held-out seeds
risks: tuning the suite to the visible cases (the held-out mix and the kappa against hidden labels catch it); a suite that flags everything (the false-fail mark catches it); a copy of the failure log (it fails on new order numbers)
kill_switch: a signed record withdraws the course; no score from it enters a tier, rank, bond floor or eligibility
